recap.paragraph: Boston College beat Syracuse 27-15 in its last game. On Saturday, the 5-6 Eagles visit No. 4 Miami in Florida. The 10-1 Hurricanes have won 12 ACC games in a row! Miami's Darian Mensah has 3,317 passing yards and 29 touchdowns this season. Miami has a spot in the ACC championship game. Boston College has a chance to reach a bowl with a win.
